raw:
The user wants UI strings in Traditional Chinese (Taiwan usage) for a list page fetching data from backend:

- s1: status text while waiting/loading
- s2: error message when fetching fails
- s3: button after failure (retry)

Taiwan UI conventions:
- s1: "載入中…" — Taiwan uses 載入 not 加載. Common: "載入中…" or "正在載入…"
- s2: "載入失敗" or "無法載入資料，請检查網路連線後再試" — something like "資料載入失敗，請稍後再試。" Taiwan: "無法載入資料" hmm. Common Taiwan app error: "載入失敗，請檢查網路連線後重試。" Let me write: "資料載入失敗，請檢查網路連線後再試。"
- s3: Retry button: "重試" — Taiwan uses "重試" commonly. Or "重新載入". Button after failure: "重試" is standard.

Use ellipsis "…". Output only JSON object.</think>{"s1": "載入中…", "s2": "資料載入失敗，請檢查網路連線後再試。", "s3": "重試"}

parsed.s2: 資料載入失敗，請檢查網路連線後再試。
